## sstat_running
cmd: sstat -a -j 2332861 -P -n --format=JobID,NTasks,AveCPU,AveRSS,MaxRSS,TRESUsageInAve%300,TRESUsageInMax%300
rc=0 ms=51

## sacct_running_steps
cmd: sacct -j 2332861 -P -n --format=JobID,JobName,State,ExitCode,Elapsed,NodeList,AllocTRES,TRESUsageInMax%300
rc=0 ms=30

## sacct_completed_gpu_tres
cmd: sacct -j NONE -P -n --format=JobID,JobName,State,ExitCode,Elapsed,MaxRSS,TRESUsageInAve%400,TRESUsageInMax%400
rc=1 ms=25

## sacct_failed_states
cmd: sacct -u $USER -S now-30days -X -P -n -s F,TO,OOM,NF,PR,CA,BF,DL --format=JobID,JobName,State,ExitCode,DerivedExitCode,Reason,Elapsed,End,NodeList | tail -25
rc=0 ms=26

## stdout_path_stat
cmd: p=$(scontrol show job 2332861 -o | grep -o 'StdOut=[^ ]*' | cut -d= -f2-); echo "$p"; stat -c '%s bytes mtime=%Y' "$p"
rc=0 ms=38

## scontrol_listpids_job

## squeue_array_expand
